lista.titulo: Academic Management System — Colegio Juan Velasco Alvarado
lista.cliente: Private school in Peru · built entirely by me
lista.problema: This school kept enrollment, grades, schedules and attendance in scattered spreadsheets, with no way to tell a parent whether their child had arrived.
lista.resultado: One system: centralized academic information and automatic daily notifications. Security and peace of mind.
modulos: Admin panel: users, students, enrollment, sections and academic terms
Teacher panel: grade entry, attendance control and weekly schedule
Biometric attendance: the browser streams frames to the recognition service and the record is written automatically
Parent notification bot: automatic Telegram message on detected arrival
Grade lookup bot for teachers: PIN authentication and an AI Agent with tool calling
System help bot: replaces the static manual and accepts voice questions
Parent linking bot: ID verification before notifications are enabled
lista.arquitectura: Architecture with separate modules (students, attendance, grades, enrollment, schedules, telegram and eight more modules). Facial recognition lives outside the app: the browser captures a frame every 500 ms and sends it to the VPS service, which returns the identified student.

lista.problema: Studying long material with nobody to quiz you: rereading it never tells you whether you actually understood it.
lista.resultado: An installable PWA: you upload the material, the AI generates questions using it as the only source and grades instantly — with per-user usage control.
modulos: Question generation with OpenAI in JSON mode, validated with Zod before it reaches the user
Instant grading with feedback, without revealing the answer at generation time
Admin panel: users, roles, expiry, usage limits and Markdown material upload
Single active session per user, bcrypt hashing and rate limiting at 5 attempts per 15 minutes
Installable as a PWA with its own manifest and icons
lista.arquitectura: Next.js with route handlers protected by role-aware middleware, Supabase as the database with an atomic function for the usage counter, and NextAuth with custom credentials.

lista.problema: Almost nobody can prove their automations actually work: most stay locked inside the client's account with no way to show they function.
lista.resultado: I published the flows without exposing sensitive data, each with its own README and diagram. You can import them into your own n8n and see exactly how they work.
modulos: Real-estate quoting bot — client in Mexico: walks the salesperson through 14 steps, computes amounts by payment plan and returns a finished PDF (including a variant that accepts voice notes)

Instagram analytics pipeline — for an anchor account with 95K+ followers: 400+ historical posts, metrics by hour, day and content type, and semantic caption analysis (topic, emotion, narrative structure)
Medical reports — radiology report drafts generated with GPT-4o and inserted into the Google Docs template, with state tracking to avoid duplicates
SIGEPS system — bulk PDF download from a government portal with Playwright, session validation, per-row error handling and Drive sync
School bot system — the four flows from the project above, also published
lista.arquitectura: The node counts and technologies on this page are not hand-written: they are read from these very JSON files at build time and the badges are derived from each node's type field.

lista.problema: Selling books online and subscriptions with no visibility, limited to social media alone.
lista.resultado: A bilingual site where payment triggers delivery: the webhook confirms the purchase and the buyer gets the link instantly, served from private storage with server-side validation.
modulos: Stripe with Payment Links, automatic delivery webhooks and recurring subscriptions, plus PayPal
Private Vercel Blob storage and a download proxy with server-side authorization
Transactional email with Resend on the site's own domain
Full SEO: canonical, hreflang, JSON-LD schema and llms.txt for AI crawlers
lista.arquitectura: Astro with minimal islands so the content stays static, and Tailwind v4 with custom tokens.

lista.titulo: L'Atelier d'Ana — home bakery with WhatsApp ordering
lista.cliente: Home bakery in Lima · built entirely by me
lista.problema: Ana baked to order but had no digital menu: every order meant explaining the full menu and prices over chat, one by one.
lista.resultado: A landing page with a full catalog, prices in soles, and a direct WhatsApp button per product — the customer sees the menu, picks what they want, and orders without back-and-forth.
modulos: Product catalog filterable by category (Classics, Specials, Premium)
Per-product card with description, price in soles, and a direct WhatsApp button
"About Ana" section and customer reviews
lista.arquitectura: Astro with Tailwind and top-layer transitions — the menu and prices are static content, and the order button is a plain WhatsApp link with no automation behind it.

lista.titulo: Pablo — AI financial assistant on WhatsApp

lista.problema: A product with active users needed onboarding and payments to stop depending on manual intervention.
lista.resultado: I designed the onboarding flows and payment automations in n8n for the second release, and contributed to the landing page frontend.
modulos: New-user onboarding flows in n8n
Payment automations and subscription state handling
Landing page frontend in Astro and Tailwind v4
lista.arquitectura: Contribution inside a remote team, on a product already in production.

negocio.titulo: What I automate is usually what your team does by hand today.
negocio.bajada: Real cases, with the before and after that stuck.

lista.delta: from a full afternoon → minutes on Telegram
lista.antes: The salesperson opens a template, works out the down payment and installments for each payment plan and builds the PDF. Every quote eats part of the afternoon and any distraction becomes a wrong number.
lista.despues: The bot answers and returns the PDF already calculated and formatted. Quoting happens from a phone, in front of the client.
lista.prueba: Delivered to a real-estate developer in Mexico

lista.delta: from writing it all → reviewing and signing
lista.antes: Every report is written in full even though the structure never changes: technique, findings, conclusion.
lista.despues: The draft arrives generated inside the template and the doctor reviews and signs. The system marks what was already processed so no study is repeated.

lista.delta: from one by one → automatic batches
lista.antes: Someone logs into the government health portal, looks up each record and downloads the PDF by hand, session after session.
lista.despues: A Playwright flow validates the session, downloads in batches, handles errors row by row and leaves everything organized in Drive.

negocio.cierre: If any of this sounds familiar, tell me and we'll see if it's worth automating.
